literal: Goodness of mind well possessors even if, to the noble ones goodness of company protection it possesses.
translation: Even if noble people possess great goodness of mind, the goodness of their company provides them with added protection.
modern: சான்றோர்கள் சிறந்த மனநலத்தை முழுமையாகப் பெற்றிருந்தாலும், அவர்களுக்கு நல்லினத்தின் சேர்க்கையே மேலும் பாதுகாப்பைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that inner virtue alone is not always enough; the external environment matters greatly. Even for noble individuals who already possess a strong, good mind (மனநலம்), being in good company (இனநலம்) acts as a necessary fortress. The word 'ஏமாப்பு' signifies a safeguard or reinforcement, showing that good associations secure and strengthen one's inherent virtues against negative influences.
